skills.description: Reviews a skill that the user or their team authored, to check whether it is well-structured, correctly formatted, clearly instructed, safe, and maintainable. This skill should be used when the user wants to self-check, lint, or audit their OWN skill before shipping it, asking things like "check whether my skill is well-formed", "is there anything wrong with the skill I wrote", or "review my skill". It produces a percentage-scored problem list with fix pointers — it does NOT decide whether to install a third-party skill (use skill-vetter for that).
